headline: GOLD DROPS $50 AS HORMUZ ATTACK SPIKES CRUDE ABOVE $90 — 30-YR YIELD HITS 5.31%, 19-YEAR HIGH
snippet: Gold spot fell to $4,367 on August 18 — down $50.70 (-1.15%) intraday — as a Strait of Hormuz attack pushed crude oil above $90 per barrel and the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield surged to 5.31%, its highest level since 2007. The twin macro shocks hit gold from both directions: rising long-dated yields increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion, while the energy price shock raises near-term inflation expectations and reduces the probability of near-term Federal Reserve easing. Markets are now pricing a 30-35% probability of a September rate hike, down from last week's low but elevated enough to keep tactical gold longs cautious. Wednesday's release of the July FOMC minutes (2:00 p.m. ET, August 19) is the next binary catalyst: the July 28-29 meeting had three dissenting members who favoured an immediate rate hike, and the minutes will reveal how much influence that hawkish minority carries into autumn. For junior mining equity investors, the $50 pullback after gold's Monday close at $4,473 is a tactical setback but leaves the medium-term bullish structure intact as long as $4,400 holds on a weekly close.

headline: McFARLANE LAKE JUBY GOLD HITS 6.2M OZ — MRE SURGES 59% IN INFERRED OZ, ALL HOLES HIT GOLD
snippet: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited (CSE: MLM) reported August 18 an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the Juby Gold Project in Ontario that lifts the total resource to approximately 6.2 million gold ounces — comprising 37.17 million tonnes grading 0.95 g/t for 1.14 million indicated ounces plus 180.67 million tonnes at 0.87 g/t for 5.06 million inferred ounces, with an additional 1.82 million tonne pit-constrained inferred resource at 1.29 g/t from the newly established 826 Zone. The updated MRE represents a 59% increase in inferred ounces from the 3.17 million reported in September 2025 and a 13% lift in the indicated category. Every single diamond drill hole in the program intersected gold mineralization, providing a consistent geological framework across the Juby system. At a gold price assumption of US$4,600 per ounce, the combined resource rises to 1.20 million indicated and 5.40 million inferred ounces. Located approximately 90 km west of Temiskaming Shores, Ontario, Juby is advancing toward a Preliminary Economic Assessment as drilling continues — a CSE-listed junior delivering back-to-back resource growth at a time when district-scale Ontario gold assets are attracting institutional attention from producers with capital to deploy.

headline: SILVERCORP KYZYLTASH: 1.68 g/t Au OVER 212.5 METRES — 3,640M MAIN ZONE OPEN AT DEPTH IN KYRGYZSTAN
snippet: Silvercorp Metals Inc. (TSX/NYSE: SVM) released August 18 the first batch of drill results from 29 diamond drill holes at the Kyzyltash Sulfide Gold Project in Kyrgyzstan, confirming broad gold mineralization in the Main Zone across a strike length of 3,640 metres — including a headline interval of 1.68 g/t gold over 212.5 metres. The results come from Silvercorp's 70%-owned Kyrgyzstan subsidiary ZAAV, which launched a 50,000-60,000 metre drilling campaign on June 22, 2026, targeting both infill to convert inferred resources into measured-and-indicated and step-out extensions of the Main Zone. The 29 holes span Lines 1480m to 5120m along strike, confirming multiple sub-parallel mineralized structures in addition to the Main Zone that were previously unknown — a resource expansion signal. The mineralized system remains open at depth and along strike beyond the current 3,640-metre defined envelope. A 212.5-metre interval at 1.68 g/t gold indicates a bulk-tonnage sulfide system; at $4,400 gold, wide low-grade-to-medium-grade gold systems in permitted jurisdictions with a major operator backing them (Silvercorp has US$175 million in cash and no debt) are exactly the development targets attracting streaming and royalty finance at premium valuations.

headline: WALLBRIDGE FENELON DRILLING RESUMES: Quebec Wildfire Evacuation Lifted After 48-Day Suspension
snippet: Wallbridge Mining Company Limited announced August 18 that the site evacuation order issued July 1, 2026 by Quebec wildfire authorities (SOPFEU) at its Fenelon Gold Project and Detour-Fenelon Gold Trend property has been lifted — allowing a phased return to normal operations with full drilling expected to resume by end of August. No damage was reported to operating facilities or camp. During the seven-week suspension, the Fenelon site hosted a SOPFEU crew of 35-60 firefighters actively managing regional wildfires. Wallbridge's Fenelon Gold Project sits on the Detour-Fenelon Gold Trend in Quebec — a 300-kilometre structural corridor that also hosts Agnico Eagle's Detour Lake mine (the largest gold mine in Canada by land area). The 48-day operational suspension was the key reason Wallbridge's 2026 drill metres have lagged expectations; the evacuation's lifting removes a significant overhang on the company's 2026 exploration narrative and should allow the program to deliver drill results before the end of the year's field season.

headline: SCOTTIE RESOURCES 25,000M DRILLED AT GOLDEN TRIANGLE — Halfway Point Reached in $26M B.C. Campaign
snippet: Scottie Resources Corp. (TSXV: SCOT) announced August 18 it has surpassed 25,000 metres across more than 100 drill holes at the Scottie Gold Mine Project near Stewart, British Columbia — reaching the halfway point of its fully financed 50,000-metre 2026 drill program. The $26 million campaign is the largest exploration program in Scottie's history and targets simultaneous resource conversion at the Blueberry Contact Zone and Scottie Gold Mine, expansion of known high-grade mineralization, and testing of multiple district-scale targets including the Bend Vein, C and D Zones, Serac Vein, Lakebed area, and Domino target. The Golden Triangle is British Columbia's premier gold discovery district — home to KSM, Brucejack, and Red Mountain — and has been exceptionally active in 2026 as record gold prices drive exploration spending. Assay results from the first 25,000 metres are expected to begin flowing in coming weeks and continue through year-end, providing a sustained news catalyst window for a company that has been relatively quiet while drilling at pace.

headline: 31.60% Cu AND 6.92 g/t Au IN 2025 OUTCROP: Midland/SOQUEM Launch Malaco Mountain IP Survey, Labrador Trough
snippet: Midland Exploration Inc. and partner SOQUEM Inc. announced August 18 the start of a 2026 follow-up exploration program at the Malaco Mountain copper-gold-rare earth element zone in Quebec's Labrador Trough — a program designed to define targets for potential drill testing following a 2025 discovery of an outcrop grading 31.60% Cu, 6.92 g/t Au, 32.4 g/t Ag, and 1.77% REE. The 2026 program includes an induced polarization geophysical survey to identify conductive zones and structural corridors consistent with the styles of mineralization seen in the 2025 outcrop. The Labrador Trough is geologically analogous to major sediment-hosted and iron-formation-associated copper-gold systems in West Africa; the combination of exceptional outcrop grades in four commodities simultaneously — copper, gold, silver, and rare earth elements — in a single surface showing is unusual and warrants systematic follow-up in a district where Tata Steel Canada operated the Carol Lake iron ore mine for decades. At $6.60 copper and $4,400 gold, discovery-stage IP surveys on multi-metal targets in Quebec are among the highest-optionality investments available in the junior sector.

headline: CANADA FLAGS $175M CHINA DEAL: Investment Canada Act Triggers National Security Review of Lithium Chile-China Union Transaction
snippet: Canada's director of investments has issued a formal notice under the Investment Canada Act flagging national security concerns about China Union Holdings' C$175 million proposed acquisition of Argentum Lithium — Lithium Chile's (TSXV: LITH) Argentine subsidiary and holder of its Salar de Arizaro lithium brine project in the Salta province of Argentina. Lithium Chile contests Ottawa's jurisdiction on the basis that Argentum is not a Canadian entity and holds no Canadian assets, employees, or offices. The closing deadline has been extended to October 20, 2026 pending resolution of the security review. The ICA national security review is the most powerful regulatory intervention available to the Canadian government and has been used previously to block Chinese acquisitions of Canadian critical minerals assets. Salar de Arizaro is one of Argentina's largest undeveloped lithium brine prospects; China Union's proposed acquisition represents the kind of transaction Western governments have committed to preventing as part of a broader strategy to secure domestic supply chains for battery-grade lithium outside Chinese control. If the deal is blocked, Lithium Chile would need to find an alternative buyer or financing partner for a project that requires significant development capital.

headline: INVENTUS MINING COMMISSIONS MAIDEN MRE AT PARDO 'RIVER OF GOLD' PROJECT NEAR SUDBURY
snippet: Inventus Mining Corp. announced August 18 that it has retained SRK Consulting (Canada) Inc. to complete a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate and updated NI 43-101 Technical Report for its 100%-owned Pardo project, located 65 km northeast of Sudbury, Ontario. The Pardo deposit — nicknamed the 'River of Gold' by the company — is an orogenic gold target in the Abitibi Greenstone Belt, the most prolific gold-producing geological terrane in Canadian history. Commissioning a maiden MRE from a firm with SRK's institutional credibility signals the project is advanced enough in terms of drill data density and geological modelling to support a formal resource calculation. For retail investors tracking early-stage Ontario gold companies, the maiden MRE is the pivotal value-creation event in a junior's lifecycle — the moment at which in-ground gold transitions from a geological concept to a monetizable asset with a tonnage and grade. The Sudbury district has historically been Canada's premier nickel-copper camp, but the surrounding Abitibi Greenstone Belt hosts multiple producing gold mines and a dense corridor of development-stage projects that have benefited materially from record gold prices in 2026.

headline: GDX EYES BEST MONTH SINCE APRIL 2020 — 5 Gold Miners Already Up 30%+ in August as Record Earnings Hit
snippet: The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) is tracking toward its best monthly performance since April 2020, with GDX gaining approximately 23.75% in August as of mid-month — a dramatic outperformance of physical gold's August gain and the product of the sector's Q2 fundamental re-rating that pushed senior producer earnings to near-record highs. Five individual gold mining stocks within the index have gained 30% or more in August alone, reflecting the momentum generated when companies reporting record margins at $4,400 gold simultaneously begin returning capital via dividends and buybacks. The August run is notable precisely because it is coinciding with gold's highest 30-year Treasury yield environment since 2007: gold miners are rallying despite the yield headwind that suppresses bullion prices, implying the equity re-rating is driven by earnings and margin expansion rather than purely gold price momentum. For retail investors who missed the initial gold price run to $5,600 in January 2026, the equity catch-up story — miners at decade-low P/E multiples delivering record cash flows — remains the most compelling unfinished trade in the precious metals complex heading into Q3 earnings season.

headline: GOLD EYES $4,600 TARGET AFTER CRACKING KEY FIB LEVEL — Kitco Technical: First Close Above 23% Retracement
snippet: Kitco's technical analysis published August 17 identifies the prior session's close at $4,473 gold futures — the first time gold opened and closed above its 23% Fibonacci retracement level at $4,435 (measured from the January 2026 all-time high to the July 17 corrective low) — as a structurally significant breakout signal pointing toward a $4,600 futures target. The analysis frames the $4,400 level as the new critical weekly close line: as long as gold holds $4,400 on a closing basis, the bullish structure is intact and the path toward $4,600 is the base case. A failure to hold $4,400 on a weekly close would shift the bias toward sideways consolidation rather than a directional breakdown. For retail investors timing entries into gold equity positions, the technical analysis is contextually useful alongside the FOMC minutes catalyst on August 19: a dovish or neutral reading of the July minutes would likely confirm the $4,400 support hold and set up the next leg toward $4,600, while a hawkish surprise would be the main scenario under which a weekly close below $4,400 becomes possible in the near term.
